signal: Closed 1m bar loses momentum immediately after close beyond preceding 30m high/low; entry next open
features: Prior breakout candle range spike >=1.6 x mean range60; body >=1.5 x median body20 then next body <=0.75 prior; wick >=35%; deep close >=0.7 x mean range60; close back inside; UTC 12-18 session; fixed combinations
warnings: No spread, slippage, commission, ASK quotes or news filtering.
Multiple comparisons and overlapping subsets; test split is exploratory after prior studies on same calendar.
Bar high/low simultaneous target-stop is ambiguous, counted as non-win.
Confidence intervals ignore time clustering and are optimistic.
High win rate on tiny sample is not robust evidence of a trading edge.
